## Logging

Winston — an alternative to the Pino default in the "logging" dimension. `utils/logger.js` exports the same `logger.info/warn/error/fatal/debug` calls every other module in this project already uses, so nothing else needed to change when you picked this. `middlewares/requestLogger.js` is a small hand-rolled request-logging middleware (attaches `req.log`, logs one line per finished request) wired into `app.js` in place of `pino-http`.
